t: Syracuse: ground atrium in the house of Dardano
d: In the bottom of the sea. Meriggio. Intense light. Patrizi, People, Women, Black Slaves, Keys, and Labdaco aside.
Rocks, rocks, a path, Egyptians, Corsari and Labdaco.
Shrine. Argelia, choir of Priestesse, then Admeto.

The Gynecean. In the background gardens - At the doric colonnade - Fountain in the middle. Nidius, Alpheus, Labdaco, Ether, Patrizi, Nocchieri, then Dejanice. Over rich Babylonian pillows, the Ether with golden pletters are softly laid. Citalist.

Two doors on both sides. - a space overlooking the sea, at the bottom. - Bronze lamps hang from the architraves. - Deep night. Dejanice alone. At the rise of the canvas, Dejanice enters the stage from the door to the left, which leads to the rooms of Dardano. It is wrapped in a rough and dark peple.
